scope: Frozen v1 and original Master3s2. Estimate the realized official pay-minus-defer terminal margin difference for an isolated, feasible base-policy planter decision. Decision outcomes from previously used development studies are ineligible. First two-map training pilot was publicly in progress, including examples of both signs, before this preregistration. No held-map scoring was inspected to set any coefficient, direction, threshold or penalty.
eligibility: Both original legal live branches must reach official termination under the same initial stream, v1 and opponent identity. Count a fit label only if a positive expenditure by the exact planter at the exact cell actually acquired the target on the pay branch, while defer had no such expenditure. A valid pay-intent miss is always archived and participates in all-intent held-terrain policy evaluation, including an observed zero effect. Source terrain, seat, turn and UID identify a paired unit; neither arm, repeated map nor shared root may enlarge the independent count. Condition on source/selector identity, never pool older incompatible protocols. The complete registered training corpus must satisfy the stated support gate before any real-data estimator or held-map diagnostic fit. LOMO training folds deliberately omit the evaluated map, without discarding that validation to inflate its own sample size.
target: Signed raw official terminal points: own minus rival for pay, minus own minus rival for the exact deferred movement. No utility/clipping or single-tree accounting substitution. Immediate debit and first-tenure income are separate audit outcomes, never input features.
estimator: Fixed 5 public feature scales, with intercept. Weighted squared terminal error plus 0.20 times squared slope norm and 0.10 times squared intercept. Each eligible paid terrain gets weight 1/M; paid roots within a terrain share it equally. Shrink toward a zero effect. No hyperparameter, orientation or sign selected from held-out scores. A coordinate more than 0.05 outside that fold's observed paid-feature ranges falls back to v1. Change at a sampled feasible root only if the alternative's predicted improvement over v1 is >=100 official points.
evaluation: Leave out every source terrain once, including both seats and both arms and all its workers. Train fold using eligible paid comparisons on other terrains only. Report each map, each chosen physical action, amount, signed observed gain against v1 (unchanged=0), equal-map average for ALL intent roots and paid/failed strata, number of changed maps, conditional prediction MAE vs zero and a training-only constant comparator. Constant comparator uses weighted shrinkage of the intercept and same support/decision threshold. Map-wise mean and one-sided 95% Student lower bound across map gains are descriptive sensitivity analyses under independent representative map effects; stratified selection and native budget/one sample per action preclude a population claim.
development: Only after data support, leave-terrain-out gate, exact physical-action/parent-prefix replay and candidate byte freeze: open the two reserved development maps in upstream protocol, run frozen v1 and candidate in both seats against full original source with native search/temperature to official terminal (8 games). Never use their results to refit. Require both map-average margin deltas positive, equal-map mean >=100 points, delta U positive in >=3/4 seat pairs, and no fewer wins; report all score pairs including draws and losses. If failed keep v1. Development comparison assesses at most one edit per game and still cannot certify formal strength.
release: No live-candidate weights or agent when support is insufficient. When support is met record full fitted checkpoint for research; only an OOF-gate-passed checkpoint plus mechanism parity permits producing the candidate. At first eligible edit make at most one single-planter change; if a defer action differs from the actual sampled rule, legal suffix changes, funding/position changes, or feature support fails, keep v1. Re-evaluate each current public state and expire proposals immediately. Opponent actions, IDs and labels are never available to model decisions.
